latest.title: otosora v0.4.0
latest.notes:
Otosora · 音空 0.4.0

Fixes
- Streamed songs stayed at 0:00 and did not play. Android blocked the connection between Otosora and its own player; it is now allowed on the phone only.
- Downloads failed with "HTTP Error 403". Otosora now keeps yt-dlp up to date by itself, once a day, and updates it and tries again when YouTube refuses a song.
- Headset and earbud buttons. On a one-button headset, press once to play or pause, twice for the next song, three times for the previous one. Earbud skip gestures now change songs.

New
- Autoplay: when a streamed queue runs out, Otosora keeps going with similar songs. It leaves out songs you heard in the last three hours or skipped early twice, drops karaoke, sped-up and hour-long versions, favours artists you play often, and plays no more than two songs by one artist in a row. Turn it off in Settings or the now playing menu.
- Driving mode: three large buttons, big type, swipe anywhere to change song, and the screen stays on. Open it from the now playing menu or the side menu.
- Player on the lock screen: when the screen turns off during music, Otosora shows the time, the song, and its controls over the lock screen. Swipe up to close. Turn it on in Settings, Playback; Android asks you to allow "Display over other apps" once.

Pick the APK for your phone. Most phones today use **arm64-v8a**.
